l.i: Doctrina sed te, te pietas, pudor,
Te cana virtus, te solidum sophos,

page.notes: The verse is set without visible stanza gaps, so each printed line is given its own paragraph rather than inventing stanza divisions. "quinis" in the last verse line is doubtful: the word is hard to make out at the scan's resolution. The lines have been changed to standard orthography for i/j and u/v only (Jocósque, Sive, iuvat, usque, Livore, ut), as the rules require. The asterisks at the foot are printed ornament, not a note.
